test_resolve_last_session_prefers_last_a: test that _resolve_last_session prefers last_active over started_at when picking the most recently used session
test_search_sessions_exposes_last_active: test that SessionDB search_sessions surfaces the last_active column and orders by most recently used
test_resolve_last_session_returns_none_w: test that _resolve_last_session returns None when no sessions exist in the database
test_resolve_last_session_closes_db_on_e: test that _resolve_last_session closes the database connection even when search_sessions raises an error
test_resolve_last_session_falls_back_to_: test that _resolve_last_session falls back to started_at when last_active is missing from legacy rows
